subject: Measurement Invariance in Lavaan: Correlating error terms of specific groups

messages.author: 5c5d70a8716db680
messages.subject: Measurement Invariance in Lavaan: Correlating error terms of specific groups
parts:
Good evening everyone.

I'm currently testing the measurement invariance of a resilience scale across 3 countries. However, when I'm using lavaan to fit the model, it seems that there is no option to correlate error terms on specific groups (e.g. correlate Item1 ~~ Item2 only on group 2) rather than to the whole model. Is there a syntax that could help me do that?

Thank you very much,

Ben

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Measurement Invariance in Lavaan: Correlating error terms of specific groups
parts: there is no option to correlate error terms on specific groups (e.g. correlate Item1 ~~ Item2 only on group 2)

So you do not even pass configural invariance?  This might be informative:

https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2017.01455
Is there a syntax that could help me do that?

Freeing it in one group but fixing it in another can be done in the syntax:

Item1 ~~ c(0, NA)*Item2 # free in group 2 only


Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
